test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

David said, “Can someone please explain what is going on?”

options.text: David asked that if someone could explain what is going on.
David said can someone please explain what is going on.
David asked whether someone could explain what was going on.
David asked if someone can please explain what was going on.

solution:
The correct answer is: **David asked whether someone could explain what was going on. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is a direct speech and we need to convert it into an indirect speech.
 
• The given sentence is also an interrogative sentence.
 
• We follow these rules in Direct-Indirect speech for an interrogative sentence:
 
 
• A question mark should always be used at the end of an interrogative sentence in direct speech.
 
• To convert direct speech to indirect speech quotation marks should be replaced by a full stop.
 
• The reporting verb '**said**' changes to '**asked**' in indirect speech.
 
• Interrogative sentence changes to assertive form [direct to indirect speech]
 
• The conjunction ‘that’ is not used to connect the clauses instead of, ‘whether’ is used for the conversion to join the clauses.
 
• The helping verb 'is' changed to 'was' in the indirect part.
 
• The modal '**can**' changes to '**could**' in the indirect speech.
 
• **Inverted commas("...")** are omitted to show the indirect speech part.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct indirect speech: *David asked whether someone could explain what was going on. *
